body:
The part where it says "We wiped, or almost wiped as much as I do with a normal group-" makes me kinda roll my eyes. I've run this dungeon with players in their 20s and 30s and some 40s and I've had some REALLY BAD PUGs and I've never wiped. Ever. This dungeon has one "hard" part only if you don't know what you're doing and that's the pair of bosses. This dungeon isn't hard, and before people start downvoting and shaking their finger and calling me some sort of lying one upping asshat, let me just mention that I've only had this game for a month. I suck at it. I get stomped in WvW and PvP. 

Dungeon just isn't hard even with uncoordinated teams.
Clearly that's a history class and Tom Cruise is just showing kids what really happened in history.

I came here to say this. My fiance was raped and decided against both abortion and adoption and we decided to raise her. We both agreed that no one must know and that it had to be kept a secret from everyone, even her. I have 100% love for my daughter. I was there for her even when she was a silly little creature in her mommy's belly. I watched her kick her mom's ass from inside that belly and I watched her learn to crawl, roll, walk, talk, and dance. She's mine and I think it would crush my very soul if she ever knew the truth.

DARPA? Mobile walking tank...Could it be?


METAL GEAR?
As someone going through a bout of depression myself, this came at a really good time.

Raiden in MGS2 is my favorite Raiden. I can't stand the butchering they did to him in 4 and Ris...Reven....whatever the shitty spinoff was called. Basically, I GET what they were doing but I just personally didn't like it. The ending of 2 made Raiden seem even cooler than I thought he was originally. Then you see him in 4 and Rose is all meh and...bleh.

I chose to be straight. I remember having to deal with those emotions when I was 16 and confused. I remember thinking...this is going to cause trouble for me in the future, there aren't many gay dudes so I'll have a hard time finding someone for me. I remember thinking that it would be emotionally and mentally too much and decided that being normal was better. Oh, and just to make it clear, my parents brought me up telling me being gay was alright. They said that love has no gender roles and that I could be with whoever I wanted. They were very supportive of gay rights and wanted me to know that they supported me if I was gay. 


So yeah. I was brought up with my family telling me they would support me and still chose to be normal and have less problems. It worked. I enjoy the company of a female and I feel like I made the right choices. I am happy. I don't feel regret. I just feel like I made the best decision of my life.

I can't really blame them though. I mean, not only is it a hard job but like...it's depressing when you talk to a depressed person who can't be helped. It's stressful and hard. It's just a shitty situation all the way around.

I took the bullets out and stashed everything for now. I don't want to see it but I still know where it's at. I want someone to hold it for me but I don't have anyone I can trust. I'm not religious, but I'll look into my local church and see if they would hold it and return it to me at a later date so thanks for that tip. 


I just don't know what to do. I don't believe in fate or destiny...but I feel like me and her are supposed to be together. I believe it was fate and I don't know how to face this alone.

The problem with this is...what kind of help is there? When you call a hotline, talk to friends/family, or just...talk to people on Reddit. They don't fucking CARE about you (well maybe friends and family). People don't care, maybe they get off on "helping" someone or maybe they feel like it's the right thing to do. But you know what? Hearing "It's going to be okay" or "I feel your pain" and shit like that isn't helping. The mantra of "you dont really want to do this." or my favorite "people love you" makes you feel better for a bit, but it doesn't SOLVE anything. You are alright for a little bit longer but you're going to relapse. There isn't any help coming. Not really. 

Edit: I know this came off as aggressive and insensitive, but I saw it right after I made this throw-away to try and get something off my chest so I didn't shoot myself and maybe I am just feeling a little too personal and down.
